question: What power arises from continually contemplating a smoky-colored form?
premises: A smoky-colored form is the object of contemplation.
The contemplation is to be done always.
The triple world is named as what may be shaken.
inference: By always contemplating a smoky-colored form, one may shake the triple world.
uncertainties: The exact object visualized as smoky-colored is not explicitly stated.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoky-colored form, one may shake the triple world.
